latest.title: Live Commerce Strategy Accelerated with TikTok JV
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 7676R
Huddled Group PLC
24 August 2026
HUDDLED GROUP PLC
("Huddled" or the "Company")
Huddled Accelerates Live Commerce Strategy with TikTok Joint Venture
Huddled Group plc (AIM: HUD), the circular economy e-commerce group, is pleased to announce further expansion of its Live Commerce strategy. Hot on the heels of its recently announced Whatnot partnership with AEWW, the Company has entered into a joint venture with Cipher, one of the UK's leading TikTok agencies, to operate Peeko Live Commerce channels across TikTok Live and TikTok Auctions.
Cipher will be responsible for the presenters and studios, while Huddled contributes stock and fulfilment, with profits split 50:50.
The partnership will see the Peeko-Beauty stream launch on the TikTok platform later this week, initially as a beta trial to prove delivery timelines, which, once satisfied, will be scaled to several hours per day, and followed by launches in Tech, and Treats, over the following weeks. Further categories will follow in the coming months as the model is honed and scaled.
Central to the deal is Huddled's newly-developed proprietary software, which connects third-party live-selling partners directly into its centralised stock and automated fulfilment infrastructure, including next-day delivery on orders placed up to 10pm. The software allows Huddled to add new Live Commerce partners and platforms with minimal incremental overhead or operational burden, underpinning the Company's route to profitability.
This is the second auction platform deal in as many weeks, underpinning the board's belief that its proprietary Live Commerce technology is a repeatable and scalable growth engine.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc
,
commented:
"Deals like this let us scale rapidly without taking on the cost or complexity of presenters, studios, or production. Cipher is one of the leading TikTok agencies and understands exactly how to maximise revenue on the platform. Combining Peeko's brand with a range of TikTok-branded live auction streams, experienced presenters, and swift next-day delivery, we believe Peeko can quickly become the leading live auction destination across multiple Live Commerce platforms - and each new platform we add strengthens the case for our technology as a scalable, repeatable growth model."
Jesper Anker and Hadleigh Banfield, Joint Managing Directors of Cipher Limited, added:
"We're excited to be partnering with Peeko on our journey to become the #1 TikTok Shop Agency in the UK. This agreement allows us to build a strong revenue stream through professional auction livestreams hosted by our skilled full time presenters and producers. Peeko's next day delivery and vast product range is particular disruptive to the TikTok Shop Auction Industry"

latest.title: Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software & JV
latest.content:
Today 07:00
RNS Number : 0303R
Huddled Group PLC
18 August 2026
HUDDLED GROUP PLC
("Huddled" or the "Company")
Launch of Proprietary Live Commerce Software and Joint Venture
Huddled Group plc AIM: HUD, the circular-economy e-commerce group, announces the launch of its proprietary live-commerce technology and the formation of a joint venture with AEWW Limited ("AEWW"), operator of the AE Stores channel on Whatnot.
Scalable live-commerce infrastructure
Live commerce is the fusion of live-streaming, auctions, community chat and entertainment. It is reshaping how consumers shop online, with platforms such as Whatnot, TikTok Shop and eBay Live driving rapid growth in buyer engagement and order volumes.
Huddled has developed software intended to address a key constraint in scaling live commerce: the coordination of stock, orders and fulfilment across multiple sellers and platforms.
The system connects third-party live-commerce sellers to Huddled's centralised stock pool and fulfilment infrastructure. This allows presenters to focus on content and sales, while Huddled manages stock allocation, order processing and delivery.
The Board considers that this integrated model enables the Group to operate a network of live-commerce channels and partners, supported by shared inventory and centralised fulfilment, improving stock utilisation and operational efficiency.
Joint venture with AEWW
Huddled has entered into a joint venture with AEWW to accelerate growth in live auctions under the Peeko brand. AEWW, which was incorporated in March 2026, has grown its AE Stores following on Whatnot to 36.5k in under six months.
Powered by Huddled's newly-developed software solution, AE Stores will be rebranded Peeko Gadgets and brought into the venture alongside the existing Peeko stores which focus on beauty and treats, with further stores to be launched on the Whatnot platform as the venture scales.
The joint venture will focus exclusively on the Whatnot platform, which is the leader in this emerging sector. Current dwell times (time a consumer spends on site) are circa 90 minutes on this platform compared to only a few minutes on traditional e-commerce platforms.
Martin Higginson, Executive Chairman of Huddled Group plc, commented:
"Our early live commerce tests produced very encouraging results, prompting us to develop a proprietary software solution for this fast-growing market. Our software lets sellers focus entirely on what they do best: selling. Behind the scenes, they will be tapping into our centralised stock pool and fulfilment engine. The ability to offer next-day delivery on these platforms will, we believe, be a genuine game changer.
"The addition of AE Stores' audience and experience provides immediate scale. Under the Peeko brand, we expect to expand into further channels, categories and partnerships."
Jason McNeill and Regan McNeill, Joint Managing Directors of AEWW Limited, said:
"The biggest challenge we faced as a business was fulfilment - every time we accelerated sales, we hit a bottleneck on stock and delivery. The partnership with Huddled will remove those barriers entirely. Being able to offer next-day delivery on orders placed up to 11pm gives us a real USP in the Whatnot marketplace.
"We can now focus on our core strength - building a strong community and driving sales in what is the fastest-growing sector in e-commerce. With the stock and fulfilment headache solved, we can scale with confidence across additional stores and streams. We are pleased to bring AE Stores into the Peeko brand as Peeko Gadgets and see strong potential to scale the model further."

company_30s.what_they_do: Hud Ltd runs a discount‑retail marketplace that sells thousands of items on the Whatnot platform, using live‑stream selling and short‑term rental of inventory.  Its core is a tech‑driven, no‑frills model that lets sellers list and sell goods in real time without traditional warehousing.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The company sits at the intersection of the booming live‑commerce wave and the UK’s appetite for budget shopping.  Live‑stream sales are growing fast, and TikTok’s partnership opens a huge audience.  If Hud can capture even a fraction of that traffic, the addressable market is multi‑billion pound.
company_30s.current_state: Hud is still building its platform and raising capital.  It has recently launched proprietary live‑commerce software, entered a joint venture with TikTok, and issued share options to attract talent.  The business is in a high‑cash‑burn, pre‑revenue phase but is moving toward a product‑market fit.

rns_narrative: The company is pivoting toward live‑commerce, accelerating its strategy with a TikTok joint venture and rolling out new software to support that model.
Capital‑raising activity – a retail‑book offer and share subscription – shows a push to fuel growth and keep the platform running.
Corporate governance updates (share option issue, AGM results) signal a focus on aligning management incentives with long‑term upside.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet optimism around the TikTok push, with very little chatter from the broader market.
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bulls argue the TikTok partnership could unlock a large, untapped audience for live‑stream sales, turning Hud into a major player in budget live‑commerce.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears fear that the business is still cash‑burning, has no revenue yet, and faces fierce competition from established discount retailers and other live‑commerce platforms.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The mood has shifted from silence to mild bullishness as the TikTok deal is announced, but overall engagement remains low.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends for the ticker is flat – the stock is essentially invisible to retail search traffic, which is a good sign for a contrarian play.

near_term_catalysts: Official launch of the Hud live‑commerce channel on TikTok – the first stream that can drive traffic and sales.
Announcement of a partnership with a major retailer or brand that will bring inventory and credibility.
A positive funding round or a clear revenue milestone that shows the business is moving toward profitability.
expect_next.watch_for: Look for a volume spike of 3–5× the average daily volume, a price touch of 0.02p (the nearest support), and a clear upward trend in the next 7–14 days.  Any announcement of revenue or a new product launch would also be a trigger.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early stages of a post‑crash recovery.  APEX compression is tight, indicating that the price is poised to break out once a catalyst confirms mean reversion.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: Hud’s price has fallen 70‑95% from recent highs, a classic deep‑crash scenario that historically yields large rebounds (average 162% return for RED signals).  If the price climbs to the midpoint of its 52‑week range, the upside is roughly 4–5× the current level.  The recent TikTok partnership is a strong catalyst that could trigger the bounce.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The business remains pre‑revenue and is burning cash.  Competition in discount retail and live‑commerce is intense, and there is no guarantee the TikTok channel will generate revenue.  Worst‑case, the price stays below 0.01p and the company fails to attract enough sellers or buyers.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss: 100% of the current price.  Potential gain: 400–500% if the price reaches the upper half of its 52‑week range.  Risk‑reward ratio: roughly 4:1, highly asymmetric in our favour.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter when the price breaks above 0.02p with volume at least twice the 30‑day average.  Place a stop 0.015p below the entry, and size the position to 10% of your trading capital.  Trail the stop once the price moves 0.005p higher to lock in gains.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until you see a volume spike of 5× the average and the price touches 0.02p.  Confirm the move with a bullish candle or a short‑term moving‑average crossover before committing.
playbook.if_passing: No terminal risk identified at this time, so we do not advise a sell‑off.  Monitor for any delisting notices or bankruptcy filings, but none are currently in play.

ai_insights.bottom_line: Hud’s deep crash, combined with a TikTok partnership that could unlock a huge audience, offers a contrarian play with high upside and limited downside – a classic 4:1 asymmetry.
